title: devx SDK docs todo - 2026-03-04
content:
Quick daily scratchpad for SDK docs work (notes to self).

High-level goals:
- Close high-priority doc gaps for SDK v0.9 release (esp streaming + function-calling examples).
- Ship a minimal end-to-end sample app for 'chat with context' that uses prefix caching example.
- Fix tutorial typos and add a short troubleshooting section for "InvalidRequest" errors.

Top tasks (today):
1) Streaming examples rewrite (PR #421) — blocker for release notes
   - Action: replace current pseudo-code with real SDK snippet that uses .stream() iterator and shows early token handling.
   - Example still TBD: show both JS and Python. Pull from internal examples repo/microservice chat.
   - Note: add comment about behavior for partial JSON outputs (common with tool-calling).
   - Est: 2-3h.

2) Function/Tool-calling example update
   - Problem: docs show synchronous function call only; need sample for async tool with retry/backoff.
   - Action: add small Node.js example using fetch + backoff util (copy from solutions-eng example).
   - Add cross-link to console docs on "structured output".
   - Est: 1.5h.

3) Sample app: chat-with-context minimal app
   - Objective: give a tiny Next.js + Redwood SDK example demonstrating:
     * local prefix caching (KV cache pseudo-code)
     * using model variants for low-cost fallback
     * simple eval harness (input/output pair)
   - Current blocker: env var names mismatch between sample and SDK config (SDK expects REDWOOD_API_KEY, sample uses RW_API).
   - Action: unify env var usage, add small docker-compose for local run.
   - Est: 4-6h to get runnable demo + README.

4) Troubleshooting section for common errors
   - "InvalidRequest: model not compatible with function-calling" -> suggestion: use compatible model or disable strict schema.
   - "401 Unauthorized" -> check API key length, team/org scopes (link to account settings).
   - Add small checklist "what to check before opening a support ticket".
   - Est: 1h.

Low priority / backlog items:
- Add a short guide on quantization profiles and how they affect latency/cost (link to research notes).
- Collect 3-5 short prompts that demonstrate hallucination regression detection for Redwood Optimize integration.
- Create a "migration guide" for users moving from old SDK v0.7 to v0.9 (breaking changes: caching API, streaming).

Open questions / decisions needed:
- Should we standardize on REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API across all sample apps? (lean REDWOOD_API_KEY for clarity)
- Do we want the sample app to include dedicated cache middleware or keep it conceptual? (PM leaning: show a working in-memory plus notes for production KV)
- Who will review streaming example? Ask Devon to take a quick look (Devon has runtime context).

Notes from convo with Mikaela (yesterday):
- She suggested adding a small flow chart for routing policies in the "advanced config" doc (nice for platform teams).
- UX: keep code examples short (<40 lines) and link to full repo for expanded version.

Quick checklist before merging docs PR:
- [ ] Update code snippets (JS + Py) to match SDK API surface exactly.
- [ ] Run sample app locally (docker-compose) and record quick GIF for README.
- [ ] Add unit/integration test for example in examples/ repo (CI smoke).
- [ ] Link to console rollouts doc for canary examples.

Random TODOs / reminders:
- Ping @devon about PR review window (today afternoon).
- File a small bug for env var mismatch (JIRA-DEVX-990).
- Draft short blurb for release notes: "improved streaming UX + function-calling examples + sample app".

Time blocking:
- 10:00–12:30: streaming examples + PR comments
- 13:30–15:30: sample app env var + docker-compose + README stub
- 16:00–17:00: troubleshooting section + cleanup

Notes to self: keep language simple, assume reader is an engineer onboarded to Redwood API but new to production tuning. Add small "next steps" section at top of each doc so folks know what to expect.

End of scratchpad.
